record_title: Generalized packing-covering holds through redundancy fifteen
provenance: Scientific sources and verification evidence are listed in RESULT.md and REVIEW.md.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The theorem advances the universal redundancy threshold only through fifteen; it does not settle redundancy sixteen or higher. The generalized Griesmer bound and the finite-reduction framework are prior ingredients, and a simultaneous or poorly indexed follow-up to the very recent source remains a residual coverage risk. No independent validation is asserted.
